## Houston 0.6.18

### A new model

- **Use GPT-6 Astra for your work**, now available in Houston's model picker.

### Start from an agent you already have

- **Create a new agent by copying an existing one**, right from the create dialog.

### Fixes and polish

- **Conversations with Gemini recover on their own**, so a hiccup mid-answer no longer stops your turn with a retry card.
- **Connecting your own local model explains what went wrong**, with the reason shown next to the connection instead of a silent failure.
- **Signing in again clears the old error**, so a provider that failed before stops looking disconnected once you reconnect.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
